scope_boundaries.lesson_a_focus: Overview of reinforced composite classifications, glass/carbon fiber forms, thermoset vs thermoplastic processing routes, hand lay-up/spray-up, structural applications, and basic property comparisons.
scope_boundaries.lesson_b_focus: Micromechanics of matrix-fiber load transfer, Kelly-Tyson critical fiber length l_c, interfacial shear strength (IFSS), fiber orientation distribution, and interfacial debonding/pull-out failure modes.

overloaded_lessons.title: Extrusion Process: Screw Design, Flow Mechanics and Die Geometry
overloaded_lessons.issue: Combines screw channel fluid mechanics, die pressure drop, and extrudate die swell into single lesson
overloaded_lessons.resolution: Boundaries demarcated. New lesson 'extrusion-die-swell-drawdown-and-dimensional-control' added to isolate viscoelastic exit flow.

overloaded_lessons.title: Vulcanization of Rubber: Chemistry, Systems & Industrial Practice
overloaded_lessons.issue: Combines sulfur vulcanization chemistry with MDR experimental cure curves and TPE physics
overloaded_lessons.resolution: Boundaries demarcated. New lessons 'rubber-mixing-and-internal-mixer-process-control' and 'thermoplastic-elastomers-tpe-tpu-tpv-structure-and-processing' added to isolate kinetics.

overloaded_lessons.title: Draft Angles & Volumetric Shrinkage Allowance in Injection Mould Design
overloaded_lessons.issue: Combines component design rules of thumb with runner balancing and tool mechanical kinematics
overloaded_lessons.resolution: Boundaries demarcated. New lessons 'multi-cavity-runner-balancing-kinetics-and-pressure-drop' and 'undercut-release-mechanics-side-cores-slides-and-lifters' added.

boundary_clarifications.domain: Extrusion Die Swell vs Melt Elasticity
boundary_clarifications.rule: Processing lesson (extrusion-die-swell-drawdown-and-dimensional-control) focuses on die geometry, drawdown ratio, haul-off speed, cooling water calibration, and dimensional tolerances. Rheology lesson (first-normal-stress-difference-recoverable-strain-and-melt-elasticity) focuses on First Normal Stress Difference N1, recoverable strain Sr, normal force cone-and-plate measurement, elastic recoil, and molecular relaxation.

boundary_clarifications.domain: GC-MS Screening vs Legal Migration Compliance
boundary_clarifications.rule: Testing lesson (gc-ms-screening-of-polymer-extractables-and-leachables) focuses on controlled laboratory extractables profiling vs real-world leachables studies, volatile/semi-volatile identification via NIST library matching, specific migration limits (SML), and Analytical Evaluation Thresholds (AET).

Processing lessons focus on polymer fluid mechanics, shear rate, and machine parameters. Mould Design lessons focus on steel tooling geometry, runner sizing, cooling channels, and actuation kinematics.

Testing lessons cover standardized laboratory protocols (ASTM/ISO) for thermal (DSC), mechanical (DMA), and chemical (GC-MS) characterization. Rheology lessons cover non-Newtonian flow equations, melt elasticity, and constitutive modeling.

boundary_clarifications.domain: Recycling Technology vs Life Cycle Assessment
boundary_clarifications.rule: Recycling covers physical/chemical process engineering (wash lines, super-cleaning, pyrolysis). LCA covers ISO 14040/44 inventory modeling, Scope 1/2/3 carbon footprinting, and EPD declarations.
